decisions.label: clear
decisions.evidence: These companies may use non-personally identifiable information (e.g., click stream information, browser type, time and date, subject of advertisements clicked or scrolled over) during your visits to this and other Web sites in order to provide advertisements about goods and services likely to be of greater interest to you.
decisions.rationale: The policy mentions collecting non-personally identifiable information but does not specify the collection of computer information for basic service/feature.
